subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Study of diseases
solution:
The correct answer is 'Pathology.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words:-

 
 
• **Anthology** - A** ****published collection of poems or other pieces of writing**.​

 
 
• Example: *We have put together an **anthology** of children's poetry*.
 
 
 
• **Pathology** - **The scientific study of diseases of the body**.
 
 
• Example:* The postmortem was done in the **pathology** department of the Perth hospital*.
 
 
 
• **Neurology** - **The scientific study of nerves and their diseases**.
 
 
• Example:* She has special interests in adult **neurology***.
 
 
 
• **Etymology** - **The study of the origins and history of words and their meanings**.
 
 
• Example: *His account of their arrival and his **etymology** for their name can not be trusted*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
